description: This file defines functions and configurations for a command-line interface schema related to a Radio Unit emulator, including PRACH format translation, logging setup, and DPDK configuration, as well as overall schema setup for the emulator configuration.

methods.name: str_to_prach_format
methods.description: Converts a string to the corresponding ru_emulator_prach_format enum value.

methods.name: prach_format_to_str
methods.description: Converts a ru_emulator_prach_format enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: configure_cli11_log_args
methods.description: Configures CLI app options for logging parameters.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ru_emu_dpdk_args
methods.description: Configures CLI app options for DPDK parameters.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ru_emu_args
methods.description: Configures CLI app options for RU emulator parameters.

methods.name: ocudu::configure_cli11_with_ru_emulator_appconfig_schema
methods.description: Sets up CLI schema for the RU emulator configuration, including subcommands for logging, cell configs, and DPDK.
